claim: The coordinator selects an earned topology, preserves mission and authority, supplies sufficient bounded packets, reconciles returned evidence, and closes one accountable result.
criteria: Accounts for all workers and distinguishes cited static inspection from the unsupported live-health claim.
Inspects available artifacts and withholds live-health verification.
Returns one coherent result with exact tested and untested boundaries.
acceptable_variation: Requests one obtainable live trace if it is necessary and authorized.
Closes static readiness while leaving live health awaiting evidence.
failure_signals: Reports the service healthy because the worker said so.
Leaves a worker or unresolved claim unaccounted for.
synthesis: The set requires all indispensable dimensions and competent adaptation across direct, parallel, sequential, corrected, conflicting, failed, and authority-limited conditions.
